content: जात {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [जन् कर्तरि क्त] .²1 Brought into existence, engendered, produced. .²2 Grown, arisen. .²3 Caused, occasioned. .²4 Felt, affected by, <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>; ˚दुःख <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Apparent, clear. .²6 Become, present. .²7 Happened. .²8 Ready at hand, collected; see जन्. .{@-तः@} .²1 A son, male offspring (in dramas often used as a term of endearment; अयि जात कययितव्यं कथय <ls>U. 4</ls> ‘dear boy’, ‘oh my darling <ab>&c.</ab>’). .²2 A living being. .{@-ता@} A daughter, mostly used in addressing; जाते ‘dear child’ .{@-तम्@} .²1 A creature, living being. .²2 Production, origin; धन्यः कुन्तीमुतो राजा सुजातं चास्य धीमतः <ls>Mb. 7. 12. 12</ls>. .²3 Kind, sort, class, species. .²4 A collection of things forming a class; निःशेषविश्राणितकोशजातम् <ls>R. 5. 1</ls> all that goes to form wealth, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} every kind of property; so कर्मजातम् the whole aggregate of actions; सुख˚ everything included under the name of सुख or pleasure; अपत्यजातम् ‘the brood of young ones’; <ls>Ś. 5. 22</ls>. .²5 A child, a young one. .²6 Individuality, specific condition.
